description: This Python source file defines a custom guardrail class 'AporiaGuardrail' for integrating with the AporiaAI API within a larger system. It includes methods for processing messages, preparing API requests, making asynchronous API calls, and handling post-call moderation, primarily to enforce guardrail policies on language model outputs.

classes.description: A custom guardrail class that interfaces with the AporiaAI API to enforce guardrail policies on LLM responses. It handles message transformation, request preparation, asynchronous API calls, and post-call moderation.
